arithmetic_contract_reference.rule: 32-bit modulo phase. note_fcw uses frozen 12-entry SEMITONES and octave shifts; f=FCW*48000/2^32. NoteOn does not clear phase. Piano uses phase[31:24]+2-bit table; Triangle uses pre-tick phase[31:22].
arithmetic_contract_reference.rounding: Integer right-shift/floor only for octave-down note FCW; no new frequency rounding.

arithmetic_contract_reference.rule: 32-bit unsigned Q16 level/start/peak/sustain; signed33 delta/step; signed59 product; quotient signed33(product>>32); elapsed13; velocity10 addresses 1024x16 ROM, effective envelope 0..32767. Per-clock pipeline retained.
arithmetic_contract_reference.rounding: Arithmetic right shifts, no added rounding. Final env=level>>16. R06 settled snapshot is lane_tick+5 pre-NBA, including updates through +4.

arithmetic_contract_reference.rule: signed16 wave times unsigned16 envelope zero-extended to signed17 gives signed33 product. Contract envelope<=32767. scaled=product>>>15; signed16 sample=scaled[15:0]; signed24 PCM={sample,8b0}.
arithmetic_contract_reference.rounding: Floor toward negative infinity, not round-to-zero or nearest.

arithmetic_contract_reference.rule: Four signed24 lane PCMs sum in signed32; no divide-by-four. Saturate to [-8388608,8388607]. clip only total>max or total<min; exact boundaries do not clip.
arithmetic_contract_reference.rounding: No intermediate truncation of the sum.

arithmetic_contract_reference.rule: PCM signed24; gains unsigned Q0.15 0..32767; product signed39; separately floor each product by15 into signed24 contributions; sum signed25 then signed24 saturation. Feedback saturates independently. Depth1024 in existing oracle. Delay0 follows the frozen read-before-write full-depth history semantics.
arithmetic_contract_reference.rounding: Two products shift separately before sum; adding effected solo PCMs is not a chord oracle.

arithmetic_contract_reference.rule: History advances for every accepted effect transaction including later publication cancellation. DSP-only work without FX acceptance does not advance history. enable0 is exact PCM bypass and does not write history. enable/length changes flush; gains-only changes preserve. Independent L/R histories; reset clears lanes/history and increments epoch.
arithmetic_contract_reference.rounding: PCM/clip tolerance is exactly 0 LSB. Old default post=lane_tick+7 is a synthetic settled-input value, not a Pro latency measurement.
